text.offer: Pritchett says, "Out past the main gate, through Kardde's Canyon, the land turns to the Badlands. A priestess of Faren keeps a fire out there, if you can believe it, and not far from her is a mana node. It's a hard walk, but every mage in my inn has made it at least once."
text.progress: From the Brownestone Inn: South Barloque, out the main gate, through Kardde's Canyon, and into the Badlands. The node is near Faren's priestess.
text.complete: Back in one piece, and with the Badlands' magic in you. Have a drink.

steps.objective: Bond with the node in the Badlands
